name: Restoration Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
You use items to remove more grave conditions.

Prerequisite(s): Restoration Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Restoration Mastery at 1st mythic tier, plus one additional use at 4th, 7th, and 10th tier. You can force the item to cast restoration by spending 2 daily uses of the feat, or greater restoration by spending 3 daily uses. If you have 9 ranks in both Heal and Use Magic Device, you can instead cause an item that has a conjuration (healing) spell of 3rd-level or higher listed in its construction requirements to cast either remove curse or remove disease. By also expending one use of mythic power, you can cast the mythic version of a selected spell instead.
